name: Custom WP Admin Login
author: Sachin G

sections.description:
Custom WP Admin Login is a simple, ultra-lightweight way to completely customize your WordPress admin login page. It replaces the default WordPress branding with your own custom logo, background, form styling, and more.

Features in Version 2.0:

  • Add a Custom Logo image, adjust its size, and set a custom link.
  • Change the Background Color or upload a Background Image.
  • Customize the Login Form Background Color.
  • Customize the Login Button Background and Text Colors.
  • Adjust the Form Border Radius (rounded corners).
  • Hide the “Lost your password?” and “Back to site” links.
  • Set a Custom Login Redirect URL to send users to a specific page after they log in.
  • Write Custom CSS to override any styles on the login page.
  • Super lightweight: Built with the native WordPress Settings API!

sections.installation:
1. Upload the custom-wp-admin-login folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Custom Admin Login in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure the plugin settings as you want.
sections.faq:
How to Use?

After activating the plugin, go to the “Custom Admin Login” under the Settings menu to configure your login screen styling.
sections.changelog:
3.0

  • Built an incredible Real-Time Live Preview feature right inside the Settings Panel! Watch your design update instantly as you change colors and settings.
  • Added native WordPress Media Uploader for Logos and Background Images instead of pasting URLs manually.
  • Reorganized the Settings layout into a clean, compact Flexbox grid.
  • Fixed WordPress 5.2+ issue where the logo tooltip title attribute was not showing up.
  • Added bottom links text color option.

2.0

  • Major Update! Completely removed the heavy Redux Framework.
  • Rebuilt the entire settings panel using the lightning-fast native WordPress Settings API.
  • Added settings to customize Form Background Color, Button Colors, and Border Radius.
  • Added option to hide the bottom links (Lost Password, Back to site).
  • Added Custom Login Redirect URL feature.
  • Cleaned up the codebase and removed external jQuery dependencies on the login screen.
  • Fixed WordPress 6.5+ and PHP 8 compatibility.

1.0

  • Initial Release.
